A 'broomed' horn is defined as a sheep horn that has been broken, splintered, frayed or rubbed in the wild, thus shortening its length and disrupting its natural taper. | Hunters must present the head of harvested juvenile rams within 10 days to a WDFW Regional or District Office or a location designated by a department representative. Call a WDFW Regional or District Office to schedule an appointment with a biologist. | Hunters are requested to avoid harvesting animals wearing collars.
